- [2023/05/26] There are approximately 440 different species of sharks in the world's oceans.

- [2023/05/26] The smallest species of sharks are the dwarf lanternshark (up to 21 centimeters) and the lanternshark (up to 20 inches).
- [2023/05/26] Shark teeth vary significantly between species based on feeding habits, with some having sharp, serrated teeth and others having flattened teeth for crushing.
- [2023/05/26] Most species of sharks are solitary hunters, but some, like hammerhead sharks and reef sharks, have been observed hunting in groups.
- [2023/05/26] There have been rare instances of group shark attacks on humans, such as the 1916 Jersey Shore shark attacks.
- [2023/05/26] If encountering a shark while swimming, remain calm, avoid sudden movements, keep the shark in view, maintain distance, and move slowly to safety if possible.
